tldr: Sun through the 2nd house brings focus to money, resources, values, and self-worth.
body: Sun transiting the 2nd house illuminates money, resources, values, and self-worth. For about a month, attention, vitality, and conscious focus move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a visibility transit: it shows where your life force wants to be recognized, strengthened, and chosen consciously.
business: Sun supports earning and resourcing: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Ego inflation, overexposure, or equating worth with what is owned or earned.
advice: Use the spotlight in the 2nd house deliberately. Work with money, resources, values, and self-worth without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from approved project house-transit material.
